product.description:
Upgrade your bathroom with the Futura Sage D-Shaped Soft Close Toilet Seat, made from durable premium thermoplastic for everyday use. Designed to fit most standard D-shaped toilet pans measuring 42.5cm x 36cm, it features adjustable hinges, top and bottom fixing options, a one-button quick release function and a soft close mechanism to help prevent slamming. Hygienic, easy to clean and ideal for adding a soft sage finish to your bathroom.

IMPORTANT – PLEASE CHECK YOUR TOILET DIMENSIONS BEFORE ORDERING

This D-shaped toilet seat measures approximately 425mm long × 360mm wide, with an internal seat opening of approximately 280mm long × 212mm wide.

The adjustable fittings are suitable for toilet pans with fixing holes positioned 60mm to 195mm apart, measured centre-to-centre.

To check compatibility, measure from the exact centre of one fixing hole in your toilet pan to the exact centre of the other fixing hole. Do not measure from the outside edges of the holes or from the existing hinge covers.

Required fixing hole spacing: 60–195mm centre-to-centre.

If your toilet fixing holes are less than 60mm or more than 195mm apart centre-to-centre, this seat will not be suitable.

Please check both the overall seat dimensions and fixing-hole spacing against your toilet before ordering.

product.description:

This oval toilet seat measures approximately 445mm long × 370mm wide, with an internal seat opening of approximately 287mm long × 235mm wide.

The adjustable fittings are suitable for toilet pans with fixing holes positioned 60mm to 195mm apart, measured centre-to-centre.

To check compatibility, measure from the exact centre of one fixing hole in your toilet pan to the exact centre of the other fixing hole. Do not measure from the outside edges of the holes or from the existing hinge covers.

Required fixing hole spacing: 60–195mm centre-to-centre.

If your toilet fixing holes are less than 60mm or more than 195mm apart centre-to-centre, this seat will not be suitable.

product.description: Supervalue 10 pack of Fernox F1 Protector, a market-leading inhibitor which prevents corrosion and limescale formation in central heating systems. This high-performance product offers superior protection by uniquely combining three inhibitors of organic particles, which bind to the metal within the heating system to protect from debris alongside anodic inhibitors which react with the system&rsquo;s metal surface to create a protective layer, and cathodic inhibitors that combine with hard water salts to form an insoluble layer. Fernox Protector F1 also includes enhanced pH buffering to ensure the system water pH level does not drop below 6.5 or above 8.5 &ndash; the optimum pH range for preventing corrosion and limescale build-up. In line with BS 7593:2019 regulations and best practice, and for long-term protection of the system, concentration levels should be maintained and checked annually as part of the boiler or system service. Protector F1 is compatible with all other Fernox products and is suitable for use with all materials and metals used in central heating systems, including aluminium.

product.description: The SolAire Exo is a fast and efficient way to heat your home. By combining high quality materials and the latest heating technology, the Exo offers energy saving features so you can stay warm while keeping your energy bills low.  For an electric radiator to work efficiently, heat must quickly passed into the room. To do this, the EXO has highly conductive aluminium panels. Heavy-Duty Construction: Thick, heavy-duty, and long-lasting for rigorous use.

product.name: URBNLIVING Extra Large Enclosed Cat Litter Blue Bottom Tray Filter Box Hooded Large Scoop Toilet Potty
product.description:
Introducing the Cat Litter Box, a practical and stylish solution designed to provide your feline friend with a comfortable and private bathroom experience. This thoughtfully crafted litter box prioritizes both your cat's needs and your convenience, making litter box maintenance a breeze. With its generous dimensions of approximately H42 x W38 x D58cm, the offers ample space for cats of all sizes to move comfortably. The enclosed design provides a sense of security for your cat while helping to contain litter scatter, keeping your floors cleaner.
Personalize your cat's space with the Litter Box's delightful range of eight style variants. Choose from a selection of vibrant bottom colours including green, violet, blue, and yellow, allowing you to coordinate with your home décor or simply select your favourite shade. Further customize the look with top options available in blue, green, grey, and yellow. This variety ensures you can find the perfect to seamlessly integrate into your living environment while adding a touch of subtle colour.
Designed with practicality in mind, the Cat Litter Box features a convenient carry handle integrated into the top. This thoughtful addition makes it easy to move the entire litter box for cleaning or relocation without any hassle. Furthermore, the inclusion of an active charcoal odour-free filter significantly enhances the user experience. This filter, easily placed within the grid of the toilette, effectively neutralizes unpleasant odours, ensuring a fresher and more pleasant environment for both you and your cat. For optimal performance, it is recommended to replace the filter approximately every 90 days.
Completing the design is a transparent flap at the entrance, providing your cat with easy and unobstructed access to their litter box. The transparency of the flap allows your cat to see through, potentially reducing any initial hesitation about entering.

product.description: The BIG Pipe Sipper Glass (250ml) The bowl of the pipe will express the aroma of your drink while you sip through the narrow pipe tube. Traditionally, port wine was served in sipping pipes, which look like large glass Smoking pipes, such as this. The stem of the pipe acts like a straw, so you sip the wine from the bottom, drinking the port that hasn’t been exposed to air. This way, most of the liquid is untouched by oxygen, reducing oxidation and preserving the wine’s original, intended flavour. Port sippers date back to the 17th century. Perfect for. .. product.description: The Hoses UK Clear PVC Corrugated Water Butt & Pond Hose is a lightweight, UV-resistant and flexible hose designed for water transfer, pond circulation, and general fluid handling. product.description: Our Beaded Aluminium Hose Joiners (Swaged Connectors) provide a robust and professional solution for joining hoses in high-pressure or high-temperature applications. Manufactured from high-grade 6063 aluminium, these joiners feature swaged ends with precision-formed beads to prevent hose blow-off and ensure a secure fit under boost or vacuum conditions. The lightweight yet strong aluminium construction resists corrosion and performs reliably in both automotive and industrial environments. These joiners are ideal for use in turbocharger systems, intercoolers, radiators, and custom intake/exhaust setups. Compatible with silicone, rubber, and other flexible hoses, they maintain a strong grip when used with standard hose clamps. The smooth internal bore promotes optimal airflow or fluid transfer without turbulence or restriction. Available in a wide range of diameters from 13mm to 102mm, offering easy integration into custom pipework setups. Whether you're repairing, upgrading, or building a new system, these connectors deliver strength, reliability, and clean aesthetics for a polished result

product.name: AutoSiliconeHoses 1m Straight Reinforced Hose Black - 40mm High-Temp High Pressure for Turbo Water Intercooler Coolant Radiator
product.description: Our Silicone Radiator Hoses are designed to deliver dependable performance in high-temperature and high-pressure environments. Manufactured with a multi-layer polyester braid reinforcement between inner and outer silicone layers, these hoses meet SAEJ20R3 standards for both automotive and industrial use. With wall thicknesses of 4.5mm or 5.5mm depending on size, they offer working pressures up to 8.3 Bar and burst ratings up to 27 Bar. Whether you're upgrading a cooling system, managing engine bay airflow, or replacing worn components, these hoses combine flexibility, durability, and reliability in one robust package.

product.name: Shower Seal for Screens Doors or Panels, Fits 4, 5 or 6mm Glass, Seals Gaps Up to 35mm, 2000mm Length, SEAL041
product.description:
This shower seal is comprised of a high quality rigid PVC U section designed to comfortably grip any glass ranging from 4mm to 6mm thick with no need for any additional adhesive. The bottom of the seal has a soft flexible fin which will seal any gap from 30mm to 35mm.

These seals are commonly found on either the bottom horizontal section of a bath screen or shower door, and can also be used vertically on the upright of the glass to create a seal between the glass and the tiles or wall. Please note that this is a straight shower seal designed only for use on straight glass.

This product comes in 800mm, 900mm, 1400mm or 2000mm lengths and can be cut down to size once you’ve received it.

Installation of our seals is nice and easy. Simply push the seal onto the glass from below on one end and work your way along, pushing the seal up onto the glass as you go. Do not try to slide the seals along the glass as this can damage it.

If you're struggling to find the correct seal for your shower/bath screen then please don't hesitate to get in contact with us. We would be more than happy to help.

product.name: Hoses UK 28mm Clear PVC Corrugated Flexible Water Butt Hose 9m Reinforced Downpipe Connector Rainwater Harvesting Pump Pond
product.description: The Hoses UK Clear PVC Corrugated Water Butt & Pond Hose is a lightweight, UV-resistant and flexible hose designed for water transfer, pond circulation, and general fluid handling. Its transparent design allows easy monitoring of water or fluid movement, making it ideal for applications that benefit from visual inspection. Manufactured with a smooth PVC inner wall and a corrugated PVC outer layer, the hose incorporates a high-tensile plastic rib reinforcement to provide durability and crush resistance while maintaining flexibility. The clear corrugated PVC hose is designed for medium-duty environments requiring a crush-resistant, UV-stable, and easy-to-handle flexible hose. Operating from -10 degrees C to +65 degrees C (peak +70 degrees C) and compliant with BS EN ISO 3994-2001, this corrugated PVC hose provides reliability, resilience, and ease of use in a variety of light to medium-duty environments. Key features include a smooth bore for consistent water or fluid flow, a flexible corrugated exterior for efficient fluid transfer, and a tough plastic rib reinforcement that resists crushing and maintains flow integrity under mechanical stress. The transparent construction allows operators to monitor flow and detect blockages or contamination quickly, which is particularly useful in pond systems, aquatics, and industrial water circulation. This hose is also widely used for workshop water transfer and light chemical solutions where visibility and flexible installation are essential. Available in a range of sizes with internal diameters from 19 mm to 50 mm and wall thicknesses from 2 mm to 4 mm, the Hoses UK Clear PVC Corrugated Water Butt & Pond Hose is suitable for a variety of applications including pond and aquarium circulation, garden water features, drainage systems, irrigation setups, and light industrial fluid handling tasks.

product.description:
This shower seal is comprised of a high quality rigid PVC U section designed to comfortably grip any glass ranging from 8mm to 10mm thick with no need for any additional adhesive. The bottom of the seal has a soft flexible bubble which will seal any gap from 10mm to 15mm.

These seals are commonly found on either the bottom horizontal section of a bath screen or shower door, and can also be used vertically on the upright of the glass to create a seal between the glass and the tiles or wall. Please note that this is a straight shower seal designed only for use on straight glass.

This product comes in 800mm, 900mm, 1400mm or 2000mm lengths and can be cut down to size once you’ve received it.

Installation of our seals is nice and easy. Simply push the seal onto the glass from below on one end and work your way along, pushing the seal up onto the glass as you go. Do not try to slide the seals along the glass as this can damage it.

If you're struggling to find the correct seal for your shower/bath screen then please don't hesitate to get in contact with us. We would be more than happy to help.

product.name: 45mm 45 Degree Plastic Hose Connector Black Barbed Hose Connector for Garden Hoses, Pond Hoses, Water Pipes
product.description: This 45 Degree Plastic Hose Connector is a practical solution for creating smooth, angled connections between hoses. Manufactured from tough, lightweight ABS plastic, it offers excellent durability and resistance to weathering, corrosion, and everyday wear. The 45-degree design helps reduce hose stress while maintaining steady water flow, making it particularly useful in spaces where a gentle directional change is required. With its barbed ends, the connector ensures a firm grip on the hose, preventing leaks and slippage even when used under pressure. Perfect for use with garden hoses, pond hoses, aquarium setups, or general water systems, this connector supports efficient water management in both domestic and professional settings. Quick and easy to install, simply push the hose ends over the barbs to achieve a secure, watertight seal. Whether used in irrigation, pond filtration, or household water projects, it helps maintain neat and organised hose routing while protecting hoses from kinking. Combining reliability, strength, and ease of use, this connector is an essential accessory for gardeners, pond enthusiasts, and DIY users who need a cost-effective and long-lasting way to manage hose connections effectively.

product.name: FloPlast Solvent Weld Waste Reducer 40mm x 32mm White Pack of 2
product.description: Solvent weld waste reducer to join a 32mm waste pipe into a 40mm pipe, commonly used where the smaller pipe drops into the larger pipe—such as the branch of a 40mm tee or one end of a 40mm coupling. Made from durable ABS and supplied as a pack of two. To install, ensure pipe and fitting surfaces are clean, apply SC250 solvent cement to both surfaces, push the pipe fully into the fitting and twist to ensure full contact, then wipe away excess cement and allow 12 hours before testing. Solvent weld joints are permanent; work in a well-ventilated area and avoid skin contact with solvent cement.

product.name: FloPlast 135 Degree Solvent Weld Waste Bend 40mm White - Pack of 2
product.description: 135° solvent weld waste bends change direction in waste pipe runs and can be used in pairs to create offsets. Available in 32mm, 40mm and 50mm sizes, this listing is for the 40mm option supplied as a pack of two. Manufactured in the UK to BS EN 1455-1:2000 and kitemarked, the ABS fittings use solvent weld jointing. To fit, ensure pipe and fitting are clean and free of grit, apply SC250 solvent cement to both surfaces, push the pipe fully into the fitting and twist to ensure full contact. Wipe away excess solvent, allow 5 minutes to set and leave the installation for 12 hours before testing. Solvent weld joints are permanent. Work in a well ventilated area and avoid contact with skin; if contact occurs, wash thoroughly with soap and water.

product.name: AutoSiliconeHoses 180 Degree Silicone Elbow Hose Red - 40mm High-Temp High Pressure for Turbo Water Intercooler Coolant Radiator
product.description: This high-performance 180-degree silicone elbow is expertly engineered for demanding applications requiring tight-radius bends and reliable flow. Manufactured with a smooth extruded silicone inner layer and reinforced with multiple polyester braids, the SSE180 offers exceptional flexibility and resilience in high-temperature environments from -50°C to +250°C. Compliant with SAEJ20R3 standards, it’s suitable for coolant, air, and water connections in automotive, industrial, and marine systems. The outer layer is made from durable silicone to ensure longevity and resistance to ozone, UV, and chemicals. Each elbow is constructed with 3 or 4 plies of reinforcement, depending on diameter, for optimal pressure performance. Wall thickness remains consistent at 4.5–5.5mm across sizes, supporting working pressures from 2.8 to 12.33 Bar and burst pressures up to 37 Bar. The 100mm leg length and tight bend radius make it perfect for compact installations. Available in a wide range of diameters (6.5mm–102mm), this elbow is ideal for both performance upgrades and OEM replacements where precision and quality are critical.

product.description: Our Silicone Radiator Hoses are designed to deliver dependable performance in high-temperature and high-pressure environments. Manufactured with a multi-layer polyester braid reinforcement between inner and outer silicone layers, these hoses meet SAEJ20R3 standards for both automotive and industrial use. Operating in temperatures from -50°C to +220°C (with peaks up to +250°C), they’re ideal for coolant and heating systems. product.name: 30mm 45 Degree Plastic Hose Connector Blue Barbed Hose Connector for Garden Hoses, Pond Hoses, Water Pipes
product.description: This 45 Degree Plastic Hose Connector is a practical solution for creating smooth, angled connections between hoses. The 45-degree design helps reduce hose stress while maintaining steady water flow, making it particularly useful in spaces where a gentle directional change is required. With its barbed ends, the connector ensures a firm grip on the hose, preventing leaks and slippage even when used under pressure. Perfect for use with garden hoses, pond hoses, aquarium setups, or general water systems, this connector supports efficient water management in both domestic and professional settings. Quick and easy to install, simply push the hose ends over the barbs to achieve a secure, watertight seal. Whether used in irrigation, pond filtration, or household water projects, it helps maintain neat and organised hose routing while protecting hoses from kinking. Combining reliability, strength, and ease of use, this connector is an essential accessory for gardeners, pond enthusiasts, and DIY users who need a cost-effective and long-lasting way to manage hose connections effectively.

product.name: 51mm to 70mm (2" To 2 3/4") Plastic Hose Connector Red Barbed Hose Connector for Garden Hoses, Pond Hoses, Water Pipes
product.description:
This Plastic 45 Degree Reducer Barbed Joiner is designed to connect two hoses of different internal diameters while providing a smooth 45° directional change. Ideal for garden irrigation, pond systems, water transfer lines, and general fluid applications, it allows flexible routing where space is limited or where a gentle angle is required to reduce hose strain.

Manufactured from durable ABS plastic, this fitting offers reliable strength while remaining lightweight and easy to install. This component is a precision 3D printed ABS part, produced for accurate sizing and dependable performance. The barbed ends provide a secure push-fit connection inside flexible hose, helping to minimise leaks and maintain consistent flow. The reducer design enables connection between two different hose sizes without the need for additional adapters.

The 45-degree angle supports improved hose routing compared to straight connectors, helping reduce kinking and stress on pipework. Suitable for use with PVC hose, rubber hose, and other flexible pipe systems, this joiner performs reliably in outdoor and wet environments. Resistant to water and general wear, it provides dependable performance for both DIY users and professional installers. Whether adapting hose sizes or changing direction within a system, this reducer barbed joiner offers a practical and efficient solution.
